methods.input: Historic entry basic cards plus public stated lineup; no 4-month form, B counts, comments or EX.
methods.classification: meeting_day from venue_info and actual round_name. Stage labels assigned before any result comparison.
methods.predictions: Current engine source replayed on historical public cards, NOT saved before race.
methods.payouts: 100JPY per distinct trifecta ticket; public settled data not crosschecked to official.
methods.strata: At most 75 races per category and stage selected by SHA256(race ID|year-race-type-v1) independent of result.
methods.caveats: Source limited to 2026-08-18 onwards. This is a preliminary 3-month slice and MUST NOT be labeled a 12-month test.

disclaimer: Only publicly available ~3 month subperiod, NOT full requested 2025-11 to 2026-11 annual period. Result-after-archive replay, exploratory only.
